title: Pseudo-random generator constructed with a constant seed in csharp — review required
description: new Random(seed) produces the same sequence every time the seed repeats, and Random is not a cryptographic generator in any case. A token or identifier derived from it can be reproduced by anyone who guesses the seed, which is usually a timestamp or a literal.
remediation: Use RandomNumberGenerator for security values and reserve Random for simulations and UI effects.
limitation: Lexical: matches a seeded Random constructor; an unseeded Random is reported by a separate rule.

tests.line: # audit: var rng = new Random(1234); present
